{"metadata":{"description":"Managing prompts，, skills, MCP tools & wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1348740564","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"prompt-skill-armory","slug":"Qian-Ning/prompt-skill-armory","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","prompt-engineering","skills"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Managing prompts，, skills, MCP tools & wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Armory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件 / 管理中枢** — 提示词、技能、MCP 工具服务器、Agent 预设、全局壁纸与特效，一站式管理面板。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**包名 / 仓库**：`prompt-skill-armory` · GitHub"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**中文** · **English**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 🎯 适配目标 · Supported upstreams"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Armory 是 **DeepSeek Harness 的插件**，专为以下两个官方仓库构建与测试："},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| 上游 | 对应环境 | 仓库 |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **DeepSeek Harness** | `dsh web` 网页端运行时 | <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness> |
